This appears to be a CBP ruling on a plush heart-shaped decoration, likely a Valentine's Day item. Festive articles fall under heading 9505, and the relevant subheading is 9505.90 ("Other" festive, carnival or other entertainment articles). The 9505.90.6000 line covers "Other" festive articles, including those of textile materials.

Stuffed decorative hearts of textile have been classified in 9505.90.6000 in prior rulings. The alternative would be 6307.90 for other made-up textile articles, but a seasonal festive decoration is better placed in 9505.

The Valentine's Day link is an inference, since the description does not say it is a festive item. A heart-shaped decoration most plausibly has that use, so 9505 is the best fit.
